verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Split Inbox dividing the inbox into user-designed categories such as "VIP", "Notifications", "Calendar", and "Team". Auto Labels automatically separate marketing and newsletter-type mail, and custom AI-prompted labels can become inbox tabs, so you can work through one topic at a time. A community user independently confirms promotional mail is routed into a separate 'other' folder. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that splits can be ordered to drive priority-order triage, and custom AI Auto Labels are limited to Business/Enterprise plans.
